name: qa_lfostep
title: OS-PERF-LFO-STEP: the step FX 23, 24, 33 and 36 on twelve tracks: sound, the export cmp and the cpu arm. The AFFECTED tracks are set once on Performance.

steps.say: OS-PERF-LFO-STEP (QA-PRF-180..189): the step FX Volume LFO 23, Panning LFO 24, Finetune LFO 33 and Position LFO 36. BEFORE the run: the tester's song `LfoStep` (twelve sampler tracks, a wavetable and a granular instrument among them) has the four FX in the first FX column, a note step each bar; a copy `LfoStepOff` is the same song without them. The AFFECTED tracks are set ONCE below (the helper that sets them toggles them: never run Performance windows back to back). By ear: each FX at a slow and a fast value; the Perform VOL LFO row over the FX and its release (QA-PRF-185). The exports are compared on the PC with `cmp` (QA-PRF-187).

steps.note: T1..T12 join the performance layer (AFFECTED), set once
the song sounds with the four step FX held

QA-PRF-188: read `render last` and the underruns, 8 reads 2.5 s apart on the run with the step FX, then the same on `LfoStepOff`; the difference is the cost of the four FX (no more than the same Perform rows, 1.2 pp)
